# openrouter.ai documentation — Client Sdks — Python

> 30 page(s) of openrouter.ai documentation — Client Sdks under Python. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Python

- [OpenRouter Python SDK](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/overview.md): Python SDK for building AI features against 400+ models through OpenRouter.
- [Analytics](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/analytics/README.md): Returns user activity data grouped by endpoint for the last 30 (completed) UTC days. Pass `workspace_id` to scope the response to a single workspace.
- [APIKeys](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/apikeys/README.md): Get information on the API key associated with the current authentication session
- [Benchmarks](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/benchmarks/README.md): Unified benchmark endpoint that aggregates scores from multiple benchmark sources (Artificial Analysis, Design Arena, and OpenRouter's own tau-bench, GPQA, and web-search evals).
- [Beta.Responses](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/betaresponses/README.md): Deprecated alias for responses endpoints. Use responses instead.
- [BYOK](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/byok/README.md): List the bring-your-own-key (BYOK) provider credentials for the authenticated entity's default workspace.
- [Chat](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/chat/README.md): Sends a request for a model response for the given chat conversation. Supports both streaming and non-streaming modes.
- [Classifications](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/classifications/README.md): Task classification market-share endpoints
- [Containers](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/containers/README.md): Lists the files in a container, in lexicographic path order.
- [Credits](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/credits/README.md): Get total credits purchased and used for the authenticated user. [Management key](/docs/client-sdks/python/docs/guides/overview/auth/management-api-keys) required.
- [Datasets](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/datasets/README.md): Public OpenRouter usage datasets.
- [Embeddings](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/embeddings/README.md): Submits an embedding request to the embeddings router
- [Endpoints](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/endpoints/README.md): Preview the impact of ZDR on the available endpoints
- [Files](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/files/README.md): Lists files belonging to the workspace of the authenticating API key.
- [Generations](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/generations/README.md): Get request & usage metadata for a generation
- [Guardrails](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/guardrails/README.md): List all guardrails for the authenticated user. [Management key](/docs/client-sdks/python/docs/guides/overview/auth/management-api-keys) required.
- [Images](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/images/README.md): Generates an image from a text prompt via the image generation router
- [Models](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/models/README.md): Returns full details for a single model identified by its author and slug (e.g. openai/gpt-4).
- [OAuth](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/oauth/README.md): Exchange an authorization code from the PKCE flow for a user-controlled API key
- [Observability](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/observability/README.md): List the observability destinations configured for the authenticated entity's default workspace.
- [Organization](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/organization/README.md): List all members of the organization associated with the authenticated management key.
- [Presets](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/presets/README.md): Lists all presets for the authenticated user, ordered by most recently updated first.
- [Providers](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/providers/README.md): Provider information endpoints
- [Rerank](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/rerank/README.md): Submits a rerank request to the rerank router
- [Responses](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/responses/README.md): OpenAI-compatible Responses API endpoints
- [Scim](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/scim/README.md): List SCIM group-to-workspace mappings for the organization. [Management key](/docs/client-sdks/python/docs/guides/overview/auth/management-api-keys) required.
- [STT](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/stt/README.md): Transcribes audio into text. Accepts base64-encoded audio input as JSON or an OpenAI-style multipart/form-data file upload, and returns the transcribed text.
- [TTS](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/tts/README.md): Synthesizes audio from the input text. Returns a raw audio bytestream in the requested format (e.g.
- [VideoGeneration](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/videogeneration/README.md): Submits a video generation request and returns a polling URL to check status
- [Workspaces](https://openrouter.ai/docs/client-sdks/python/sdks/workspaces/README.md): List all workspaces for the authenticated user. [Management key](/docs/client-sdks/python/docs/guides/overview/auth/management-api-keys) required.
